## What are the common causes of failed building fire-safety checks?

Common causes of failed building fire-safety checks include poor maintenance of fire-alarm systems, lack of fire risk assessments, blocked or inadequate escape routes, and ineffective fire extinguishing systems. Inaccurate documentation and failure to respond to identified issues are also significant factors that can lead to a failed inspection.
